verdict.rationale: Tavily is API-first: every core capability is documented as a REST endpoint and in the SDKs. That covers search, extract, crawl, map, research (with async status retrieval and streaming), plus account usage and per-request logs endpoints, so the dashboard's usage and log views also have API equivalents. Missing for 10: no explicit statement of API/UI parity, no evidence of API-based key creation/rotation or billing/plan management, no published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and no independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
